title: Command palette
description: The app-wide “search or create” box on ⌘K / Ctrl+K, built on Command: one dialog for places, records and quick actions. Mount it once in the root layout; pages register their own items with useRegisterCommands. Groups get text-overline headings, actions a coloured tile, records a hint line; the footer shows the keys, and ⌘↵ opens an item with href in a new tab.
when: Every app with more than a few pages: jump to a place or record and start a create action from anywhere (L1).
A SearchPill or “Tìm hoặc tạo” button in the header that opens the same box (openCommandPalette).

instead.need: A small action list inside a page or Popover
A palette with your own open state and no app-wide registry
Filter the list on the page

a11y: A modal dialog (focus trapped, Escape closes, focus returns); the input is a combobox that owns a listbox (aria-activedescendant), groups are labelled by their heading, disabled items are aria-disabled.

examples.title: App-wide palette
examples.description: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or the button; type “tieu” to find the supplier by keyword.

notes: A record that opens in a DetailOverlay on the current route: its `onSelect` calls `openDetail(id)` (or the page's `open(id)`), not `router.push("?open=…")` to the same route, which browsers without the Navigation API do not report to the list. Give it `href` too, for ⌘↵.
⌘K on Apple devices, Ctrl+K elsewhere (Ctrl+K on a Mac deletes to the end of the line in text fields); a key a widget already handled, or typed in a rich-text editor, does not open it.
